title: Gulbani - A Gifting Shop
description: Your private luxury gifting concierge in New Delhi. Bespoke wedding favors, heirloom brass caskets, and artisanal hampers crafted to be treasured forever.
highlights: Project Architecture & Highlights
- Frontend Architecture: Responsive, luxury editorial UI designed for seamless gifting browsing across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
- Product Catalogue: Structured gifting collections with brassware, gourmet confectioneries, bespoke hampers, and filter search.
- Shopping & Concierge Experience: Curated bridal gifting builder, customized gift hampers, and streamlined checkout.
- Admin & CMS: Centralized inventory, order fulfillment, bespoke enquiry parsing, and collection management.
- Backend Architecture: High-speed modular Laravel & PHP architecture for reliable order routing and security.
- Deployment & Performance: Optimized imagery, Vercel edge deployment, responsive typography, and sub-second page loads.

title: PRASUNA-INSPIRED-BY-YOU
description: Prasuna began with a simple sketch and a deep respect for Nepali craftsmanship. In a world saturated with mass industrial clothing, we craft intimate, limited drops that honor the artisan behind the thread.
highlights: A modern, high-converting boutique e-commerce demo website crafted for Prasuna (@prasuna.clo / Prasuna.np).

Built with PHP 8.3 & Laravel Blade Engine (illuminate/view), featuring editorial luxury aesthetics, limited drop mechanics, multi-currency switching, interactive story highlights, made-to-measure customization, slide-out shopping bag, and express checkout.

title: Omkaar Logistics ERP - System Login & Fleet Suite

title: Pragjyotishpur University - Staff & Student CRM

Implemented GPS campus geofencing for location-verified faculty attendance, ensuring on-campus presence validation.
Built instant semester SGPA results retrieval, clearance dues tracking, and student fee ledger management.
